tasks.notes:
# Task #59 — lib/cairn_narrate_server.py: drop RALPH_ env fallbacks

## Outcome

Both `remove once all projects migrated` markers in `lib/cairn_narrate_server.py`
are gone. `grep -n "RALPH" lib/cairn_narrate_server.py` → no matches.

## Changes

1. **`--socket` default (~line 216, was a two-line `default=`)** — collapsed to
   `os.environ.get("CAIRN_NARRATE_SOCKET", DEFAULT_SOCKET)`, dropping the
   `RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET` leg. The marker comment above it is deleted along with
   the code it described.

2. **API key resolution (~lines 225-241)** — dropped the
   `RALPH_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` lookup and its `[cairn] Using legacy
   RALPH_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY...` stderr warning. Chain is now just
   `CAIRN_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Per the task instructions,
   **kept** the explanatory comment (now trimmed to drop the "legacy" framing):
   why the prefixed name exists (main loop blanks `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` to force
   Max-plan usage before spawning `claude`) and that it mirrors
   `resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain()` in `src/config.ts`. Removed the
   `remove once all projects migrated` marker line since the fallback it
   flagged is gone.

## Verification

- `python3 -m py_compile lib/cairn_narrate_server.py` → OK, no syntax errors.
- `grep -n "RALPH" lib/cairn_narrate_server.py` → empty.
- `bun test` → **838 pass, 0 fail, 31 files** — same count as task #58's run
  (this file has no dedicated test suite, as the task description noted, so no
  count change expected).
- Did **not** modify `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` and did **not** run
  `./install.sh`, per task instructions.
- Did not touch any of the excluded paths (tasks.completed.json,
  .cairn_iterations.log, .cairn_tasks_snapshot.json, reviews/round-*.md,
  .ralph_task_*_notes.md, audit/).

## Notes for future tasks

- `test/legacy-markers.test.ts` still passed (part of the 838), confirming no
  other line in this file references the old name without justification —
  there was none to begin with after this change.
- No discovered tasks this iteration — the task matched the codebase exactly,
  no unrelated bugs or missing functionality surfaced.

tasks.title: Decide the fate of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain — no production callers remain
tasks.description: Task #51 deleted warnIfLegacyApiKey and its two call sites (src/commands/narrate.ts, src/commands/run.ts), which were the only consumers of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain(). The function is still exported from src/config.ts and covered by test/config.test.ts, but nothing in src/ calls it — the resolution is now purely documentary, mirroring the same chain in lib/cairn_narrate_server.py (see task #59). Either (a) delete the helper, its AnthropicApiKeyResolution type, and its tests, leaving the Python server as the single implementation, or (b) keep it and give it a real caller — e.g. have runNarrate/runRun pass the resolved key into the narration server env instead of relying on the child process re-reading the environment. Do NOT normalize onto plain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY under either option: the loop deliberately blanks that name to force Max-plan usage. Sequence this after #59 so both sides of the mirror are decided together.
